subject: general
question: Solid Carbon dioxide is commonly called as ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**dry ice.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

 
• Solid carbon dioxide (CO₂) is commonly known as dry ice because it does not melt like regular ice but instead sublimates directly from a solid into a gas.
 
• It is colorless, odorless, and non-flammable and can lower the pH of a solution when dissolved in water, forming carbonic acid (H₂CO₃)
 
• **It is used for various purposes, such as refrigeration, transportation of frozen goods, and in the entertainment industry for creating smoke or fog effects.**
 
• **It sublimes at 194.7 K (−78.5 °C; −109.2 °F) at Earth's atmospheric pressure.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
 
• Heavy water, or deuterium oxide, is a form of water in which the hydrogen atoms are replaced by deuterium, a heavier isotope of hydrogen.
 
 
• **It is used as a moderator in nuclear reactors.**
 
 
 
• Aspirin, also known as acetylsalicylic acid, is a medication used for pain relief, fever reduction, and anti-inflammatory purposes.
 
• Table sugar, or sucrose, is a disaccharide composed of glucose and fructose.
 
 
• **It is commonly used as a sweetener in food and beverages.**
